newsitem.title: UK: BFI up five, more enquiry reported.
newsitem.headline: BFI up five, more enquiry reported.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was up five to 1,269 points on Wednesday with Panamax rates in the index continuing to edge forward marginally.
Brokers reported more active grain chartering enquiry for panamaxes and handy-sizes in particular in most areas. But this has yet to be reflected in higher rates.
Halla have fixed Dooyang Hope for 54,000 heavy rgain USGulf to Japan for end May/early June at a basically unchanged $21.20 no combo.
At 1200 gmt BIFFEX was fifteen to eight points higher in the traded positions where volume totalled 82 lots.
